description: This file contains internal utilities, class templates, and functions for implementing parameterized tests in Google Test framework, including generator classes, iterator classes, and registration mechanisms.

classes.name: TestParamInfo
classes.description: Template struct holding test parameter info with value and index.

classes.name: ParamIteratorInterface
classes.description: Interface for iterating over generator elements.

classes.name: RangeGenerator
classes.description: Generator for a range of values with a step.

classes.name: ValuesInIteratorRangeGenerator
classes.description: Generator from a pair of iterators.

classes.name: ParameterizedTestFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating parameterized test instances.

classes.name: TestMetaFactoryBase
classes.description: Base class for test factory meta-creation.

classes.name: TestMetaFactory
classes.description: Creates test factories for parameterized tests.

classes.name: ParameterizedTestCaseInfoBase
classes.description: Abstract base for parameterized test case info.

classes.name: ParameterizedTestCaseInfo
classes.description: Holds info about a parameterized test case, including tests and generators.

classes.name: ParameterizedTestCaseRegistry
classes.description: Registry managing all parameterized test cases.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a string name for a parameter.

methods.name: GetParamNameGen
methods.description: Returns the parameter name generator function.

methods.name: AddTestPattern
methods.description: Adds a test pattern to a parameterized test case.

methods.name: AddTestCaseInstantiation
methods.description: Adds a generator instantiation to a test case.

methods.name: RegisterTests
methods.description: Registers all tests for a parameterized test case.
